rule_candidates.rule: WHEN the yield-curve regime is bear flattening or bull steepening THEN do not read it as a BTC direction signal over 5 or 20 days
rule_candidates.when: curve regime (narrative.curve, 5-obs DGS2 / DGS10 changes) = bear_flattening or bull_steepening
rule_candidates.then: treat the regime as macro context only; any directional idea needs its own evidence
rule_candidates.effect: in-sample bear flattening +5d z -0.075 (Holm p 0.63), +20d +0.019; bull steepening +5d +0.148 (Holm p 0.34), +20d -0.024; holdout signs mixed; H-MAC1 inconclusive in both segments
rule_candidates.review: re-run H-MAC1 when the clean holdout has >= 40 bear-flattening and >= 40 bull-steepening days, or with pre-2020 BTC if the user adds it

rule_candidates.rule: WHEN a bull steepening comes with the HY spread easing THEN expect a better 20-day BTC outcome than when it comes with HY widening, as an unconfirmed tendency only
rule_candidates.when: curve regime = bull_steepening and the 5-obs change in BAMLH0A0HYM2 < 0 (vs > 0)
rule_candidates.then: weight the user's thesis (c) trigger (bull steepening with credit easing) as the better branch; do not trade the split by itself
rule_candidates.effect: eased minus widened 20d z +0.32, 95% CI [-0.12, +0.77] (n 70 / 65 days, 2023-11..2026-11); same sign in both segments; H-MAC2 inconclusive
rule_candidates.review: HY OAS on FRED starts 2023-11-14; re-test with a longer credit series or after more holdout bull-steepening days

rule_candidates.rule: WHEN a ledger thesis is active or strengthening THEN cite it as narrative context and never as the reason a trade beats the driftless base rate
rule_candidates.when: research/desk/<snapshot>/theses.json status in (active, strengthening) for an asset's thesis
rule_candidates.then: put the thesis in the narrative layer of the confluence log and in honesty.conflicts when it cuts against an idea; direction claims still need R-BUDGET-1's justification
rule_candidates.effect: no tested edge: H-MAC1 and H-MAC2 inconclusive; the ledger is scored forward only
rule_candidates.review: after 20 scored theses, compare their signed horizon returns with zero and with the paired desk baselines
